Booz Allen Hamilton is seeking a Junior Wireless Infrastructure Engineer to support mission-focused IT infrastructure initiatives. The role involves developing prototypes, experimenting with emerging IT and 5G wireless technologies, collaborating with clients and technologists, and planning and implementing infrastructure components.

Responsibilities
As an IT infrastructure engineer on our team, you’ll help develop IT systems prototypes and experiment with emerging IT and 5G wireless technology to support critical mission use cases
You’ll work with clients and a varied team of technologists to learn the strategic goals and operational needs that shape the IT requirements
You’ll then have the opportunity to plan and implement IT infrastructure components
From resolving interoperability issues across platforms, to supporting the prototyping of solutions, you’ll put your hardware and software talents to good use

Required
* 1+ years of experience with IT infrastructure systems
* 1+ years of experience with network design and integration of network technologies
* Experience implementing, configuring, and operating virtualization solutions, including VMware
* Experience in container technology, including Docker, and container orchestration, including Kubernetes
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
* Ability to implement, configure, and operate servers, including Windows and Linux
* Ability to develop technical briefs and convey technical concepts to a varied audience
* Secret clearance
* Bachelor's degree
Preferred
* Knowledge of networking concepts and principles
* Knowledge of cloud concepts and principles
* Knowledge of wireless networks
* Knowledge of cellular communication networks, including 4G and 5G
* Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Microsoft Certified Administrator or RHCS Certification
* CCNA, CCNP, or 5G Certifications
